cite.title: Insert a citation
cite.search: Search author, title, year or key
cite.noLibrary: No sources yet: add a .bib or .csl.json file to the vault, or copy your Zotero library (desktop app).
cite.synced: Zotero library copied into the vault: {n} sources.
cite.zotero.disabled: Zotero's local API is off. In Zotero: Settings → Advanced → "Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero".
cite.zotero.notRunning: Zotero isn't running on this computer. Open Zotero 7 and try again.
cite.zotero.browser: Zotero only answers apps on this computer, not web pages: copy the library from the desktop app.
legalCite.title: Legal citation
legalCite.f.name: Name
legalCite.f.collectionYear: Collection year, if not the law's
legalCite.f.title: Title
legalCite.f.issue: Issue (only if each issue starts at page 1)
legalCite.hint.ruling: Fill the report for a printed ruling; leave it empty and give the database and date for an unpublished one.
legalCite.hint.law: Type a date (1997-03-05) in Year to fill the Hebrew year. A Basic Law: give the collection year instead.
legalCite.hint.book: Authors' full names, as the rules write them.
legalCite.hint.article: The title is written in quotation marks.
legalCite.rules: כללי האזכור האחיד בכתיבה המשפטית, 3rd edition (Tel Aviv University, 2021).
